locator_reproducibility_findings: SRC-016 `exact_locator` is a search-query URL; the record URL in `evidence_url` resolves. Re-fetch by a later auditor using only `exact_locator` would fail.
SRC-069 `exact_locator` is a search-query URL; same defect, and SRC-069 was not in the citation-integrity-C enumeration of 28 such rows, so that enumeration was incomplete.
Neither defect changes any claim: both records were re-verified from their canonical record URLs in this pass.

declared_verification_check.question: Does any ledger row's verification_status overstate the evidence its sources actually carry?
declared_verification_check.method: cross-join of all 62 L0 rows to their source_ids in ledger/citation_audit.csv, comparing verification_status against evidence_type (abstract/full-text vs metadata) and against row status
declared_verification_check.result: 0 overstatements. The single verification_status='unverified' row (D-009) is status='provisional' and is supported only by 2 metadata-only sources, which is the honest classification. No accepted row has only metadata-only sources. Rows marked abstract-read all have at least one abstract or full-text source.

method: Two-channel live re-fetch. Channel 1: an independent subagent with no ledger access and no write access fetched 4 locators (3 arXiv abstract pages, 1 Crossref API) and compared title / first author / year / stored excerpt against the live content. Channel 2: the lead re-fetched 4 further locators (2 arXiv abstract pages, 2 INSPIRE API records) and 2 Crossref DOI records, with the same comparison. Normalization allowed whitespace, case, punctuation, LaTeX-vs-unicode and HTML markup; ellipses were treated as skipped text. No content from the ledger was treated as evidence of itself.
limitations: Abstract-level only. No publisher PDF body or paywalled full text was read, so theorem numbers, section numbers and proof statements remain unverified for these 8 records.
The 8 targets are a purposive sample weighted toward load-bearing, machine-resolvable pre-2026 sources; they are not a random sample of the 97.
2025/2026 preprint-only entries (SRC-078..SRC-085, SRC-091 and similar) were not live-fetched in this pass; several are past the auditor channel's resolvable range.
Independence: only the 4 subagent checks are independent of ledger authorship. The 4 lead checks corroborate but do not count toward the independent minimum.
falsifier_outcome: The assignment falsifier ('a row whose verification_status claims more than its recorded verification page supports') was tested directly by the cross-join and found NO occurrence at this hash. Two locator-level defects (non-reproducible exact_locator on SRC-016 and SRC-069) were found and are recorded as metadata defects, not evidence overstatements.
verdict: G-LIT independent re-fetch criterion (>=3 checks) is now MET at the frozen hashes: 4 independent + 4 corroborating live re-fetches, 0 contradictions. This artifact does NOT accept L0/L1 and sets no gate verdict; it supplies the missing spot-check evidence for a reviewer.
